articles.title: Bitcoin miners are oversold following 35% October rout, VanEck says
articles.snippet: Investors dumped AI infrastructure providers across the board in October, treating companies in very different sectors as one monolithic trade.

articles.title: Binance, Deribit revoke SignalPlus API keys after fake Teams invite attack
articles.snippet: SignalPlus said attackers compromised an engineer’s computer in a breach that resulted in losses of less than $82,000, which the crypto trading platform pledged to reimburse in full.

articles.title: Europe’s largest asset manager Amundi tokenizes equity index fund on Ethereum
articles.snippet: The new share class offers blockchain-based exposure to an index tracking 600 companies across European markets.

articles.title: Paraguay president resigns after collapse of Ueno digital bank
articles.snippet: Santiago Peña stepped down amid mounting scrutiny over his former ties to Ueno Bank’s parent company, as the lender’s collapse left millions of customers unable to access their funds.

articles.title: Can decentralized phone networks power the AI revolution?
articles.snippet: Decentralized AI networks want to turn everyday phones into an alternative to centralized computing infrastructure — but skeptics have their doubts.
